stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class); no Common Data Set could be found on the UW-Whitewater site. ACT percentiles are from IPEDS for the 73% of enrolled first-time students who submitted ACT; IPEDS lists no SAT percentiles. College Navigator fall 2024 shows 10,187 applicants and 86% admitted. No GPA, international-applicant or residency splits are available. Undergraduate enrollment (10,084) and the 21:1 student-faculty ratio are from College Navigator, fall 2024.
